user_job: Validate multi-tenant isolation and parallel execution lineage for legal document workflows using native EOS primitives

acceptance_criteria.description: Ambient tenant_id propagates automatically across all workflow executions
10 concurrent tenant workloads execute without context collision or corruption
Lineage, artifacts, and execution traces never leak between tenants
traceExecutionByDecision() only returns events from the correct tenant's context
All evidence events include tenant_id for compliance auditing
No new multi-tenant managers or isolation layers added - extends existing primitives
Throughput remains at 95% of single-tenant baseline with 10 concurrent tenants
Separate tenants executing identical workflows have unique decision_ids that never collide

evidence: 10 concurrent tenants executed in 20ms with zero context leakage
tenant_id added to core execution primitives without architectural drift
traceExecutionByDecision() now supports tenant filtering for compliance queries
